entities.summary: The Basilica Papale di San Lorenzo fuori le mura is a Roman Catholic papal minor basilica and parish church, located in Rome, Italy. The Basilica is one of the Seven Pilgrim Churches of Rome and one of the five papal basilicas, each of which was assigned to the care of a Latin Church patriarchate. The basilica was assigned to the Patriarchate of Jerusalem. The basilica is the shrine of the tomb of its namesake, Lawrence, one of the first seven deacons of Rome who was martyred in 258. Many other saints and Pope Pius IX are also buried at the Basilica, which is the centre of a large and ancient burial complex.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As one of the five papal basilicas and a major pilgrimage site, the Basilica of Saint Lawrence Outside the Walls has played a significant role in shaping Christian tradition and influencing the development of Western art and architecture. Its association with several saints and popes has also contributed to its enduring historical importance.
